snippet.title: Mutants vs The Chosen: Hijack - Free Point and Click Adventure Game for Android
snippet.description:
Video of Mutants vs The Chosen: Hijack - Free Point and Click Adventure Game for Android created in GameStylus.com engine.

The future has brought destruction to some places on Earth. Some people are suffering from poverty, disease and visible genetic mutations.

Although the mutations are typically small, they are often used as a pretext to attack the Mutants by the Chosen. The gunmen steal, destroy and kill. This time, they chosen a small village in the shadow of the ruined city, where Riam lives with his father and sister. Maybe it's time to stand up to the Chosen.

Features:
* free to play
* multilanguage (English, German, Czech, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese)
* classic point-and-click adventure game optimized for tablets and smartphones
* original from GameStylus.com team

Created on GameStylus.com.

Hot tip: You can create your own adventure games at GameStylus.com! No programming necessary!
